note: Kossuth County Conservation Board park on 145-acre Burt Lake, a glacial lake on the Minnesota line 11 mi north of Swea City. Six camper sites on top by the open shelter (gravel or grass pads 30-50 ft) and four down the hill toward the lake access in the west tree line (gravel pads 32-57 ft), plus four tent sites by the lake; water from hydrants; unimproved boat ramp, mowed hiking trail. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: $20 a night, 20/30/50-amp, no dump, lakeview on 145-acre Burt Lake. Corrected: booking was 'reservable online' (now walk-in, pay on site, 14-day limit); toilets are porta-potties, not vault; season set to about Apr 15-Oct 31. Camper site count is 10, not 14.
flags: WATERFRONT OK (lakeview), with an up-lead for site 10 only: Burt Lake is 145 acres. The county map and site pages put the four bottom sites (7-10) on a lane descending to the lake access, Site 10 being 'the lakeside site at the bottom of the hill'; the county's photos from the bottom pads show open lawn with picnic tables and the lake about 25-35 m beyond. On Esri the lower lane's north end is about 25-30 m from the shore over grass with scattered trees. But that lawn is the lake access and unimproved boat ramp, with the tent sites T-1/T-2 at the shore, which reads as a used strip, so I keep lakeview. The six top sites sit in woods by the shelter about 80-120 m from the water.
BOOKING WAS WRONG: stored reservable true (from the note); every site page says 'This Facility is only available for Pay on Site' and the fee is for 'walk-in sites ... paid at the time of arrival'.

SITE COUNT: MyCountyParks lists 10 camper sites (Top 1-6, Bottom 7-10) plus 4 tent sites; stored 14 (the note's '~14 electric' is wrong; all 10 camper sites have power). The county's campground map JPG numbers the lake-lane sites 9-13 differently from the listings. Count left at 14 for AWH: 10 if count means RV sites.
FACILITIES: stored vault_toilets true came from the note's 'pit latrines'; the county says porta potties and no modern restroom, so I cleared vault_toilets and set flush_toilets false.
FIT OK: pads range 30-57 ft; Top 1 (50 x 20 ft grass), Top 4-6 (42-50 ft) and Bottom 8-10 (52-57 ft) fit; Top 2-3 and Bottom 7 (30-36 ft) are tight.
PHONE MISSING: 515-295-2138 (Kossuth County Conservation, 'Call for Availability' on the site pages).
PIN OK: 43.49850,-94.38350 is on the top loop by the shelter.
